text: He is the LORD our God; His judgments are in all the earth.
"Do not touch My anointed ones, And do My prophets no harm."
There the LORD greatly increased [the number of] His people, And made them more powerful than their enemies.
He also struck down all the firstborn in their land, The first fruits and chief substance of all their strength.
So that they might observe His precepts And keep His laws [obediently accepting and honoring and valuing them]. Praise the LORD! (Hallelujah!)
